title: Approximate tangent planes are invariant under dilation (parent step 3, orientation bullet)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, M ⊆ ℝ^P an arbitrary set, c > 0, z ∈ ℝ^P and Q a linear subspace of ℝ^P. If Q is an approximate tangent space of M at cz in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, 1.4 (SimonGMT HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M (cz) Q: finrank Q = n and, for every f ∈ C_c(ℝ^P, ℝ), ∫_{η_{cz,r}(M)} f dH^n → ∫_Q f dH^n as r → 0⁺, where η_{x,r}(y) = r^{-1}(y − x)), then Q is an approximate tangent space of {x : cx ∈ M} = c^{-1}M at z.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (c : ℝ) (z : Euclid P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < c → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M (c • z) Q → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n ((fun x => c • x) ⁻¹' M) z Q
